conventions.encoding: an element of GF(2^m) is the integer sum c_i 2^i, i.e. bit i is the coefficient of x^i
conventions.graph: symmetric circulant Gamma_ij = c_{delta(i,j)}, delta(i,j) = min(|i-j|, n-|i-j|), zero diagonal, over GF(q); the state is q^(-n/2) sum_x (-1)^Tr(sum_{i<j} Gamma_ij x_i x_j) |x> (paper Eq. (1))
conventions.hermitian: generator [I | A] of an F_256-linear code of length n; A is n/2 x n/2 built from circulant blocks circ(r)_{ij} = r_{(j-i) mod len(r)}; for n = 20, A = [[C00, C01], [C01^T, C11]]; Hermitian conjugation x -> x^16
conventions.canonical: the candidate files are the same states in the verifier's canonical F_2 form (m qubits per party; X in the polynomial basis of GF(q) over F_2, Z in its trace-dual basis); qlib_ame.py is the converter that produced them

twist.statement: c_{8j mod 21} = c_j^4 for all j (multiplier 8 combined with x -> x^4)
